summary: @jasongreen Aperture is on a server run and hosted by @aaronpk. I don't run my own instance. I haven't tried installing on a shared host, but don't see why not. Sublime is just my text editor. It has a mobile app, nobody wants to publish websites that way.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @jasongreen Aperture is on a server run and hosted by @aaronpk. I don't run my own instance. I haven't tried installing on a shared host, but don't see why not. Sublime is just my text editor. It has a mobile app, nobody wants to publish websites that way.
